items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they turned the money over to Mona and Lee Coners wife... Tommy Corners was the treasurer, Mona was the president... She took Lee Coners wife’s place who passed away.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then we did and they turned the money over to Mona and Lee Coners wife [Unintelligible] Coners and it was that if a musician needed some money, he could borrow it and if he could pay it back, he could pay it back. There was no real stipulation that you really had to pay it back.
But if you needed it you could get it.
